cash_tip: Papá Omar and Jahgyro Gyros both take cards, so you can save your pesos for the spots that don't. When you do need cash, use a bank ATM in town instead of a standalone one, always pick 'decline conversion' so you're charged in pesos, take out a bigger amount once, and keep small bills on hand for tacos, taxis and the market.
